title: Пропущенные дни

positive.sql: SELECT d.generated_date AS missing_date FROM v_generated_dates AS d LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT visit_date FROM person_visits) AS v ON v.visit_date = d.generated_date WHERE v.visit_date IS NULL ORDER BY missing_date;

negative.why: дни, когда не ходил кто-то один (Andrey), а не все
negative.sql: SELECT generated_date AS missing_date FROM v_generated_dates WHERE generated_date NOT IN (SELECT visit_date FROM person_visits JOIN person ON person.id = person_visits.person_id WHERE person.name = 'Andrey') ORDER BY missing_date;

negative.why: IN вместо NOT IN: дни, когда посещения были
negative.sql: SELECT generated_date AS missing_date FROM v_generated_dates WHERE generated_date IN (SELECT visit_date FROM person_visits) ORDER BY missing_date;
SELECT generated_date AS missing_date FROM v_generated_dates WHERE generated_date NOT IN (SELECT visit_date FROM person_visits) ORDER BY missing_date DESC;
SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('2022-01-11'::date), ('2022-01-12'::date)) AS t(missing_date) ORDER BY missing_date;
